/**
 * The resolved client address of this call, for rate limiting and audit. Without a resolved value (an application that
 * does not install the resolver) it is the raw socket peer, never `origin` - which a forwarded-headers plugin could
 * rewrite - and never `remoteHost`, whose reverse lookup would replace the numeric peer of a CIO keep-alive connection.
 */
fun ApplicationCall.clientAddress(): String = attributes.getOrNull(CLIENT_ADDRESS) ?: request.local.remoteAddress

/**
 * Installs the account HTTP contract and its authentication infrastructure.
 *
 * @param publicRoot route root for operations a public API-key client calls; documented in the public OpenAPI document.
 * @param internalRoot route root for browser-session, organization and staff operations; documented only in the
 * internal OpenAPI document.
 */
fun Application.configureAccounts(
    accountModule: AccountModule?,
    settings: SecuritySettings,
    publicRoot: Route,
    internalRoot: Route,
) {
    configureAccountErrorHandling()
    if (accountModule == null) return

    configureAccountSessions(settings)
    configureAccountAuthentication(accountModule)
    internalRoot.installAuditRequestContext()
    AuthRoutes(accountModule).register(internalRoot)
    CurrentUserRoutes(accountModule).register(internalRoot)
    OrganizationRoutes(accountModule).register(internalRoot)
    InvitationRoutes(accountModule).register(internalRoot)
    ApiKeyRoutes(accountModule).register(internalRoot)
    StaffRoutes(accountModule).register(internalRoot)
    AuditRoutes(accountModule).register(internalRoot)
    ApiKeyIdentityRoutes().register(publicRoot)
}
